operation_order: concatenate four disjoint OOS folds within seed
compute each metric on each 228-date seed history
take the arithmetic mean of the ten seed-level metric values for ranking
report median, sample standard deviation, min, max, p10 and p90 separately

average_return_path.cost_interpretation: net returns, turnover and costs were computed per policy before averaging; they were not recomputed from netted average weights

benchmark_asymmetry.td3: distribution over ten training seeds on one market path
benchmark_asymmetry.benchmarks: one deterministic historical path and no training-seed distribution
benchmark_asymmetry.benchmark_seed_dispersion: unavailable, represented as neutral/NaN rather than zero
benchmark_asymmetry.robust_score_status: retained with unchanged weights as a diagnostic only; not primary evidence of TD3-versus-benchmark superiority

canonical_sharpe.name: annualized_arithmetic_mean_to_sample_standard_deviation_sharpe
canonical_sharpe.formula: weekly arithmetic mean / sample std(ddof=1) * sqrt(52)
canonical_sharpe.ranking_input: mean of ten per-seed canonical Sharpe values for TD3

white_reality_check.formula: sqrt(T) * max mean weekly candidate-minus-benchmark net return differential
